MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 2
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 49
   D. 2

5. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

6. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 18 cm³
   B. 12 cm³
   C. 9 cm³
   D. 27 cm³

7. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.7
   B. 23.6
   C. 23
   D. 29

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.6
   C. 21
   D. 15.7

9. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. They are equal

11. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 24.5
   B. 7
   C. 8
   D. 49

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 33
   C. 22
   D. 28

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
